name: Compose application
description: A platform-agnostic container-based application defined as a set of containers that run together with shared resources + comms. Authored as one or more YAML files conforming to the Compose Specification. The unit `docker compose up` brings up.

name: Compose project
description: An individual deployment of a Compose application on a platform. Top-level `name` (or `-p`/`--project-name` flag, or env `COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME`) — used to prefix all resource names + label `com.docker.compose.project`. Lets the same compose.yaml be deployed twice on the same host without collision. Project names: lowercase letters, digits, dashes, underscores; must start with a letter or digit.

name: Compose service
description: An abstract computing component implemented by running the same container image (and config) one or more times. Top-level `services.<name>` map. Each service maps to one or more containers (per `deploy.replicas` or scale). Ports, volumes, networks, env, depends_on attached here.

name: Compose network
description: A platform-capability abstraction for IP routing between services. Top-level `networks.<name>`. Maps to a Docker network of the chosen driver (default `bridge`). Services attach via `services.<name>.networks`. Implementation details (driver, options) live under the network entry.

name: Compose volume
description: Top-level `volumes.<name>` declaration of a persistent filesystem mount. Services reference it via `services.<name>.volumes`. Driver-options pass through to the volume driver. Read+write (configs/secrets are read-only).

name: Compose config
description: Top-level `configs.<name>` for non-sensitive runtime configuration data. Mounted into containers as a file (default 0444). Distinct from a volume because the platform may source it from a config service rather than a filesystem path. `external: true` to reference an existing platform config.

name: Compose secret
description: Top-level `secrets.<name>` for sensitive data — same shape as a config but with platform-specific secure storage. Mounted as files at `/run/secrets/<name>` by default. Read-only.

name: Compose profile
description: Set of named profiles activating subsets of services. Services without `profiles` are always enabled; services with `profiles` are only enabled when one of them is active. Activated via `--profile <name>` (repeatable) or `COMPOSE_PROFILES`. Targeting a profile-bound service explicitly auto-activates its profiles.

name: Compose extension fields (x-*)
description: Any top-level or service-level field starting with `x-` is a Compose-spec extension. Ignored by the spec; useful for tool-specific metadata, YAML anchors, and template patterns (`x-base: &base ...`).

name: Compose include
description: Top-level `include` reads in additional Compose files. Each entry can be a string path or `{path, project_directory, env_file}`. Each include is resolved as a sub-project; conflicts with the parent are errors. Lets large applications stitch together vendor-supplied compose snippets.

name: Compose watch
description: `develop.watch[]` rules: file-watcher hooks. Each rule has path, target, action (sync|rebuild|sync+restart), ignore[], exclude[]. Triggered by `docker compose watch` (or `docker compose up --watch`). Foundation for hot-reload dev workflows.

name: Compose file merging
description: Multiple `-f`/`--file` files (or env `COMPOSE_FILE`) merge into one model. Override files (the second+ file) replace simple values, append to lists, deep-merge maps. Last writer wins on scalar conflicts. The mechanism behind the `compose.yml` + `compose.override.yml` pattern.

name: depends_on
description: Service-level dependency declaration. Compose creates services in `depends_on` order, removes in reverse. Two forms: list (`depends_on: [db, redis]`) or map with conditions. Without conditions, only ordering — Compose doesn't wait for app readiness, just for the container to be running.

name: depends_on condition: service_healthy
description: `condition: service_healthy` waits for the dependency's `healthcheck` to pass before starting the dependent service. The recommended way to handle 'app starts before DB is ready'.

name: depends_on condition: service_completed_successfully
description: Wait for the dependency to run to successful completion (exit 0). Pattern: a one-shot migration / seed service the main app waits on.

name: depends_on condition: service_started
description: Default condition. Wait for the dependency's container to be `running` (NOT for app readiness). Equivalent to bare `depends_on: [name]`.

name: depends_on restart: true
description: Restart the dependent service when the dependency restarts (e.g. `docker compose restart db` triggers `web` restart). Ensures connections/dependencies are re-established.

name: service deploy strategy
description: Service-level `deploy.mode` (`replicated` or `global`). Replicated runs N replicas anywhere; global runs one per node. Swarm-only at runtime; non-Swarm Compose sees these as advisory.

name: service restart policy
description: Two ways: top-level `restart: no|always|on-failure[:N]|unless-stopped` (Compose-managed; runs on host docker), OR `deploy.restart_policy` (Swarm-managed). They have different semantics — `restart` is the docker-engine-level policy; `deploy.restart_policy` adds delay/max-attempts/window/condition.

name: service healthcheck
description: Service-level `healthcheck`: test, interval, timeout, retries, start_period, start_interval, disable. Override the image's HEALTHCHECK or define one for an image without. `service_healthy` depends_on condition uses this.

name: deploy.mode: replicated
description: Service runs `deploy.replicas` instances. Default. Most common for stateless services.

name: deploy.mode: global
description: Service runs exactly one instance per Swarm node. Used for node agents (monitoring, log collectors).

name: multi-file merge
description: `docker compose -f base.yml -f override.yml up`. Override file's values: scalars replace, lists append, maps deep-merge. Production-vs-dev pattern: `compose.yml` + `compose.dev.yml`.

name: extends
description: `services.<name>.extends`: import a service definition from another Compose file (or same file). Merge with local overrides. Distinct from include (which brings in whole sub-projects).

name: YAML anchors + aliases
description: Standard YAML `&anchor` / `*alias` works in compose.yaml. Combined with `<<: *anchor` for map merging. Pattern: define `x-shared-env: &shared { ... }` and reuse via `environment: *shared`.

name: build context (compose)
description: `services.<name>.build` either a string (=context dir) or a structured object. Compose builds the image locally instead of pulling. Build args, secrets, ssh, cache_from/cache_to, target stage, platforms — all available.

name: build vs image
description: `build` and `image` can both be specified — Compose builds, then tags the result as the `image` value (so subsequent runs can `pull` instead). Without `image`, the built image gets a Compose-managed name like `<project>-<service>`.

name: replicated deploy mode
description: deploy.mode=replicated + deploy.replicas=N. Standard for stateless services. Combine with deploy.update_config for rolling updates.

name: global deploy mode
description: deploy.mode=global. One container per node. Used for node agents.

name: replicated-job deploy mode
description: deploy.mode=replicated-job. One-shot job that runs N times across the swarm and exits. Newer mode.

name: global-job deploy mode
description: deploy.mode=global-job. One-shot job, one execution per node.

name: rolling update_config
description: deploy.update_config: parallelism, delay, failure_action (continue|rollback|pause), monitor, max_failure_ratio, order (start-first|stop-first). The Swarm-style rolling-update knob set.

name: rollback_config
description: deploy.rollback_config: same shape as update_config. Triggered by failure_action: rollback, or by `docker service rollback`. Defines how to revert a botched deploy.

name: deploy.placement
description: deploy.placement: constraints (label-match expressions), preferences (spread by node attribute), max_replicas_per_node. Pin services to nodes by labels — e.g. `node.role==manager` or `engine.labels.zone==eu-west-1`.

name: deploy.resources.reservations
description: deploy.resources.{limits, reservations}.{cpus, memory, pids, devices, generic_resources}. Limits = hard cap (cgroup); reservations = scheduler hint (Swarm scheduling, not enforced at runtime).

name: healthcheck.test
description: Either `["NONE"]` (disable an image's HEALTHCHECK), `["CMD", arg, ...]` (exec form), or `["CMD-SHELL", "shell line"]` (shell form — wraps in /bin/sh -c). Exit 0 = healthy, 1 = unhealthy.

name: healthcheck.interval
description: Time between health-check runs. Format: `30s`, `1m30s`. Default 30s.

name: healthcheck.timeout
description: Max time per probe. Probe killed + counted as failure if exceeds.

name: healthcheck.retries
description: Consecutive failures before container is marked unhealthy.

name: healthcheck.start_period
description: Initial wait before counting failures. Lets the app boot without flapping unhealthy. Default 0s.

name: healthcheck.start_interval
description: Probe cadence during start_period. Faster than `interval` so health is detected quickly post-boot.

name: interpolation: ${VAR:-default}
description: `${VAR:-default}` — use `default` if VAR is unset OR empty. `${VAR-default}` — use default only if VAR is unset (empty allowed).

name: interpolation: ${VAR:?error}
description: `${VAR:?error}` — error out if VAR is unset OR empty. `${VAR?error}` — error only on unset. Use to fail-fast on missing required env.

name: interpolation: ${VAR:?msg} vs ${VAR?msg}
description: Distinction: `:?` errors on unset+empty; `?` errors only on unset. Same difference applies to `:-`/`-`.

name: interpolation: substring ops
description: Bash-style param expansion: `${VAR#prefix}`, `${VAR##prefix}`, `${VAR%suffix}`, `${VAR%%suffix}`, `${VAR/pattern/replacement}`. Implemented per-platform; portable subset is the unset/empty operators.

name: interpolation: ${VAR}
description: Bare `${VAR}` — empty string if unset (warning logged). For required vars, use `${VAR:?}` instead.

name: --env-file / .env loading
description: Compose loads `.env` from project dir by default (CLI: `--env-file <path>`). KEY=VALUE per line; comments with `#`. Loaded BEFORE interpolation so vars are visible to `${VAR}`. Distinct from `services.<name>.env_file` (that one populates the container's env, not the YAML's).

name: service startup order
description: Compose creates services in `depends_on` topological order. Cycles are errors. Without `condition`, dependency = 'created and running' (NOT app-ready). On `down`, services are removed in reverse order.

name: service shutdown order
description: Reverse of startup — `web` (which depends on `db`) is removed first, then `db`. SIGTERM grace from `stop_grace_period` (default 10s) before SIGKILL.

name: default network
description: If a project doesn't declare networks, Compose creates a default user-defined bridge named `<project>_default` and attaches all services to it. So services resolve each other by name out of the box.

name: local volume driver
description: Default volume driver on `local` Compose. Maps to `docker volume create -d local`. Driver-opts pass through (type=nfs, device=:/path, o=addr=...). Cross-host volumes need NFS/CIFS or another driver.

name: compose tmpfs
description: `services.<name>.tmpfs` (string or list) mounts an in-memory fs at the given path. Cleaned on container stop. Distinct from a volume — no persistence, no driver.

name: secret mode bits
description: `services.<name>.secrets[].mode` (octal) sets the file mode of the mounted secret in the container. Default `0444`. Lower bits useful when an app refuses to read world-readable files (e.g. ssh keys: 0400).

name: config source vs target
description: `services.<name>.configs` entries: `{source: <config-name>, target: <container-path>, uid, gid, mode}`. Default target `/<source>`. The decoupling means the same config can land at different paths in different services.

name: tty
description: `services.<name>.tty: true` allocates a pseudo-TTY. Useful for shell-on-PID-1 services (interactive).

name: stdin_open
description: `services.<name>.stdin_open: true` keeps stdin open. Combined with tty=true mirrors `docker run -it`.

name: restart on-failure
description: `services.<name>.restart: on-failure[:N]` — restart up to N times if container exits non-zero. Limit isn't supported by all platforms; without N, retry indefinitely.

name: service pull_policy
description: `services.<name>.pull_policy`: missing|always|never|build|if_not_present. Default `missing`. `if_not_present` is an alias for `missing`. `build` says: rebuild from `build` block instead of pulling.

name: YAML << merge
description: `<<: *anchor` injects an anchor's keys into the current map. Combined with extension fields (`x-base: &base { ... }`) gives a 'mixin' pattern for shared service config.

name: init (compose vs container)
description: `services.<name>.init: true` runs an init process as pid 1 (forwards signals + reaps zombies). Equivalent to `docker run --init`. Don't confuse with the daemon's `init: true` (sets default) or top-level `name: init` (project name).

name: compose.yaml top-level shape
description: Top-level keys: `name` (project), `services`, `networks`, `volumes`, `configs`, `secrets`, `include`, `x-*`. The legacy `version` field is now ignored. Convention: `compose.yaml` (or `compose.yml`); legacy filenames `docker-compose.yaml`/`yml` still picked up.
